# Other clients & SDKs

Any MCP client that supports **remote servers over Streamable HTTP** with **OAuth 2.1** (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration) works:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gupshup": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```
Clients that only support local (stdio) servers can use the [`mcp-remote`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mcp-remote) bridge:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gupshup": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

No Gupshup Enterprise account yet? Email [sales@gupshup.ai](mailto:sales@gupshup.ai).

Something not working? See [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md).
